input_probe.protocol:
Exploratory CPU check: does E22M prior's frame input retain zombie location?

Compare raw tile192, prior tile8 and global frame512 using grouped ridge readouts.
All models frozen, same five true-frame depths, roots split by episode/seed.
These are finite linear readouts on opened diagnostics, not information ceilings.
No world training, posterior encoding or CUDA use; outputs into the existing health_chain_v1 EDA store.

prior_fit.protocol:
Exploratory CPU FP32 prior fit: 20k vs60k, same frozen posterior labels.
Retains per-root/per-future code scores; contextual deterministic information
in each code means these are code-fit strata, not decoded move probabilities.
CUDA disabled, two threads. Outputs into the existing health_chain_v1 EDA store.

prior_calibration.protocol:
CPU exploratory temperature calibration of frozen E22M code priors.

Select temperature on validation episode clusters and score disjoint test
clusters. Previously inspected diagnosis panel; this is mechanism evidence.
Posterior targets are frozen. Temperature cannot change argmax accuracy.

alive_future.definition: Future transitions only, including first terminal target, excluding later frames; 4 codes per transition

real_key_control.control: Independent real simulator keys1..4 vs realized key0 under E22 alive-any/drop/same masks. No camera-alignment conditioning; compares caught_all rather than caught_aligned. Empirical real-simulator baseline, not a proven information ceiling.

limitations: Opened exploratory diagnostic panel, no new sealed verdict.
CPU FP32 metrics; canonical GPU code scores retained separately.
Finite linear location probes; no information-theoretic bound.
Temperature result is teacher-forced code fit; no sampled-rollout or actor test.
Real-key event control uses caught_all masks without camera-alignment conditioning.
Thresholded zombie scores require independent semantic validation.

prior_terminal_position_census.protocol:
CPU census of death-target positions in dworld.train_b's current sampler.

Measures supervision support; does not test whether the trained head uses time
as a shortcut. E22 imagination does not use this termination head.
